title: Do Teachers Dream of GenAI Widening Educational (In)equality? Envisioning the Future of K-12 GenAI Education from Global Teachers’ Perspectives
reasoning: The paper qualitatively evaluates the impact of GenAI on moral development, ethical boundaries, and cultural values in the classroom. It specifically examines teachers' roles as moral guides and discusses the opposition to GenAI from conservative religious groups and the integration of moral frameworks like Ubuntu into AI education.
